Comments for Epi25 phenotype data
 
# Epilepsy type

## primary_classification field

Records are classified by epilepsy types according to the ILAE classification of the Epilepsies (2017)
  -  Genetic generalized epilepsies (GGE)
  -  Focal cases
  -  Mixed cases
  -  Cases  combining features of  GGE and Focal types
  -  Epileptic Encephalopathies (EE)
  -  Unclassified epilepsy

Samples with no phenotyping records different from controls should be considered as unclassified.

For cases that cannot be classified into either but have a solid foundation of being an epilepsy cases, not another condition associated with seizures.

## Seizure classification

Seizures also follows the guidelines of the ILAE.
We record onset and last recorded age of seizure where available.
For some focal and GGE cases, other_focal_seizures and other_seizures are captured separately but the onset is only recorded as other_age_onset and other_age_last.
Some cases also have an age of onset recorded but the appropriate seizure type not listed correctly.
We will resolve the discrepancy in updates.

## Hippocampal sclerosis

The condition hippocampal sclerosis (HS) is coded in two ways in the data, one as a finding of neurological imaging as well as a classification in hs_detail, which contains annotation signifying conditions not considered HS.
